name: Fandiablos
text: Warning Barks: before drawing threats, reveal one local threat and record whether it stays or gets driven under the deck. Swarm of Tiny Teeth: during a Grit battle, use Fandiablos to gain +3 Grit for that battle. Unreasonable Courage: the first wound each round may be prevented on 4+. Cable Biters: gain +2 on Forge or Guile tests involving machines, locks, traps, or salvage. Too Many Dogs: after use, on a mayhem roll of 1 the action becomes unstable.

activeEffect.text: Fandiablos is awake: warning barks, tiny teeth, and cable biting support are committed to the current action window.

acquisition: Complete 3 Contracts and draw Fandiablos from the Artifact/Ultimate deck.
Win a special Shrine or Companion event.
Defeat a named nemesis tied to beast-flock lore.
flavor: They came through the breach barking. The enemy line broke before command understood why.
imagePrompt: A grimdark fantasy-sci-fi character card showing a heroic operative surrounded by a chaotic flock of tiny armored Chihuahuas, each wearing miniature ward collars, goggles, scraps of black-gold armor, and tiny glowing sigils. The dogs are cute but fierce, barking into smoke and sparks inside a ruined gothic-industrial battlefield. Cinematic lighting, dark brass, red heat-glow, blue breach light, ornate Ashenreach card style, no text.
